entries.name: Destiny Islands collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: The playable island visit ends when the storm begins. On day two, pass through the door beside Kairi to the Cove. Check the tower alcove before turning in the final supplies. Raft materials, provisions and the Empty Bottle are temporary story objects, so they are not world-collection checks. The two Kairi supply bonuses are distinct opportunities; their item varies with hints.

entries.name: Traverse Town collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: First District connects the shops and world exit; the door behind the Accessory Shop leads to Second District. Second District contains the hotel, Dalmatians' House and Gizmo Shop. The upper Gizmo route crosses the roofs to a Third District balcony. Cast Fire on the flame-marked Third District door, cross the moving stones and circle Merlin's house to its entrance. Red Trinity opens the Alleyway sewer route; Green Trinity in the Accessory Shop lowers the Item Workshop ladder. Geppetto's House opens after Monstro. Revisit Pongo and Perdita to claim rescued-puppy milestones.

entries.name: Wonderland collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: Use the Bizarre Room drink to change size. As a giant, push the bed aside; as small Sora, its opening leads to the Queen's Castle. Lotus Forest has elevated doors into different Bizarre Room orientations, and exits onto the castle hedges and Tea Party Garden. Light the two lamps beside the sideways room's painting to activate its route into the isolated Lotus Forest. Thunder on the hanging bell flowers there reveals puppies 58–60. Green/White Trinities and Glide rewards need a later return. Rabbit Hole battle rewards change at the trial and Kairi rescue; collect each phase before advancing.

entries.name: Olympus Coliseum collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: The Gates lead to the Lobby and tournament registration with Phil. Check behind the exterior columns, both statue feet, and the center of the plaza. The left torch reward requires Blizzara; return with Blizzaga for the right torch reward. Winning the Hercules Cup unlocks Yellow Trinity; use it on Phil's stone in the Lobby for the Keyhole. Cup victories and variants have their own challenge records.

entries.name: Deep Jungle collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: Camp connects to Hippos' Lagoon and Bamboo Thicket. Cross the hippos to reach the far bank, or climb the vines to the elevated Vines/Vines 2 route. Tree House and Climbing Trees are above the Tunnel/Treetop area. Beyond the Cliff after Clayton, climb the Waterfall Cavern ledges to the Cavern of Hearts. Final Mix puppies 31–33 are in Waterfall Cavern; the old Climbing Trees Blue Trinity now gives Thundara-G. Return with movement abilities for the highest tree chests.

entries.name: Agrabah collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: Climb crates and awnings to travel above the Plaza, Alley, Main Street, Bazaar and Palace Gates. Aladdin's House is reached by the pole from Main Street. In the Cave of Wonders, dropping from the upper halls enters the water chambers. Relic Chamber and Dark Chamber connect by the waterways; use the stairs to regain Cave: Hall. Yellow Trinity in Cave: Hall moves the pillar to expose the Hidden Room's other section. Move the stone block from Bottomless Hall to make the Relic Chamber crossing. Bring Aladdin for Abu statue interactions, then switch to Donald and Goofy for Trinities.

entries.name: Monstro collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: After the first Parasite Cage fight, open Geppetto's chest and equip High Jump; the lower water level exposes the Mouth platforms. A useful interior route is Mouth → Chamber 1 → Chamber 2 → Chamber 3; use the upper return doorway to Chamber 2 to reach Chamber 5, then Chamber 6. Door height matters: the same chamber has several disconnected entrances. Search both upper ledges and the floor before moving on. Chamber 5's low entrance from Chamber 6 is beside its Blue Trinity. Final Mix puppies 76–78 are in Chamber 6, while 55–57 are on Chamber 3's highest ledge.

entries.name: Atlantica collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: Attack white clams; cast Fire, Blizzard or Thunder on red, blue or yellow clams respectively. The trident signs point from Undersea Valley through Calm Depths and Undersea Cave to Undersea Gorge and Triton's Palace. Ariel's Grotto is the low entrance in the Gorge. Clear enemies before grabbing the dolphin; it carries you against the Calm Depths current to Sunken Ship. Later, Mermaid Kick lets you fight the current directly. Push the seabed geyser reached from Sunken Ship to dislodge the Gorge treasure. Swim upward as well as around walls when searching shelves.

entries.name: Halloween Town collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: Guillotine Square contains the lab and Jack's house. Graveyard leads toward Moonlight Hill, Bridge and the manor. After the manor falls, return to Manor Ruins for unopened manor chests; Final Mix preserves the red mark under the manor arch. The new Moonlight Hill doorway leads to Cemetery and its four chests. Use High Jump and Glide from high ground in Guillotine Square to reach the pumpkin-mouth tower and its opposite platform. Puppies 67–69 are the White Trinity reward on Moonlight Hill.

entries.name: Neverland collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: The Hold leads through the Galley/Cabin to Captain's Cabin; the Cabin Green Trinity opens the upper route. Flight becomes available during the ship events and reaches the Hold beams and the mast chest. After winning Hercules Cup, bring Donald and Goofy to the yellow mark on the Hold's upper locked door. The deck White Trinity gives puppies 43–45 in Final Mix. Clock Tower doors follow total playtime in repeating twelve-hour cycles; the tower is occupied by Phantom late in the game until you defeat it.

entries.name: 100 Acre Wood collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: Take Cid's Old Book to Merlin and examine it in his study. Five Torn Pages unlock episodes in a fixed sequence, whichever source page you find first. Explore Meadow and Pooh's House, then the Hunny Tree, Rabbit's House, Hill, Bouncing Spot and Muddy Path. Bouncing Spot opens the chest, tree and Rare Nut activities; only carry one Rare Nut at a time and return it to Owl before taking another. Episode completion rewards and score targets are separate from merely finding a page.

entries.name: Hollow Bastion collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: Rising Falls leads by floating rocks to Castle Gates. The gate-side lifts descend to Base Level and Waterway; Beast breaks the barred walls there. Bubble and switch routes reach Dungeon and the castle door controls. Complete the Library's book placements to open hidden Lift Stop sections. Cast Gravity on the floating treasure platforms to lower them. Great Crest connects to the two sides of High Tower; its moving stairs conceal another Lift Stop door. Grand Hall chests are collectible on the return after Kairi's rescue. Revisit Belle, Aerith and the princesses for their separate rewards.

entries.name: End of the World collection route
entries.summary: Area connections, access requirements and return-trip reminders.
entries.instructions: In Final Dimension, follow the connected invisible paths between ten treasure markers; several trigger battles before granting the item. Giant Crevasse has five chests at different heights; keep checking side platforms before entering the portal. World Terminus has one container in each replica listed here. The Hollow Bastion laboratory Elixir must be opened during that visit before continuing through the final portal. Save at Final Rest and open its chest before entering the last battle sequence; reload that save to finish other collections.

entries.summary: Orichalcum. Open 1:00 door.
entries.instructions: Visit Clock Tower when total playtime is in hour 1 of the twelve-hour cycle (for example, 1:00–1:59; later cycles also work). Fly around the tower to the glowing numbered door and examine it, then open the reward. Return in a different hour for the other doors.
entries.prerequisites: Seal Neverland; matching total-playtime hour; defeat Phantom if he is occupying the tower.
entries.missability: A missed hour returns every twelve playtime hours. Late-game Phantom temporarily blocks the tower until defeated.

entries.name: Trinity unlocks and counting
entries.summary: 46 marks: 17 blue, 6 red, 9 green, 4 yellow and 10 white.
entries.instructions: Blue: defeat Guard Armor. Red: seal Deep Jungle. Green: seal Agrabah. Yellow: win Hercules Cup. White: defeat Riku in Hollow Bastion Entrance Hall. Activate marks with Sora, Donald and Goofy in the active party. Mark activation and opening a revealed chest are separate actions. In Final Mix, Halloween Town’s red mark remains available after the manor falls.
entries.prerequisites: Reach this area; clear nearby enemies before opening a container.
entries.missability: Revisitable after the relevant access requirements are met.

entries.name: Library puzzle and Lift Stop chests
entries.summary: Book placements open the routes to puppies 97–99 and several Gravity chests.
entries.instructions: Pick up Khama vol. 8 on the ground floor and fill the gap in its red shelf. Upstairs, take Mava vol. 6 and Theon vol. 6; use Green Trinity near the table for Azal vol. 3. Put Azal in its yellow shelf. Replace the misplaced Salegg book with Mava 6; put Salegg 6 in the blue shelf. Take Nahara 5 downstairs and place it in the upstairs N shelf to reveal Mava 3. Put Mava 3 in its green shelf, collect Hafet 4 from the revealed desk and place it in the purple H shelf. This exposes the hidden Lift Stop exit. Place Theon 6 upstairs to expose the red switch for the upper Entrance Hall door. Use Gravity on suspended chest platforms beyond the hidden exit.
entries.prerequisites: Green Trinity; access to Library; Gravity for the floating chests.
entries.missability: Revisitable after the relevant access requirements are met.
entries.reward: Library exits and access to Lift Stop treasures

entries.name: Synthesis workshop and unlock sets
entries.summary: 33 recipes in six sets; unlocks count different products.
entries.instructions: Seal Agrabah to learn Green Trinity, place Sora, Donald and Goofy in the party, and activate the green mark inside Traverse Town's Accessory Shop. Climb the ladder to the Moogles. Set I starts available; sets II, III, IV and V require 3, 9, 15 and 21 distinct crafted products. Set VI requires all 30 earlier products. Crafting the same product repeatedly does not advance the distinct-product gate. The 15-product milestone also gives Encounter Plus. Finding an item elsewhere does not count as crafting it.

entries.name: Fury Stone
entries.summary: Seven defeated: Fury Stone ×2 guaranteed.
entries.instructions: Clear the three Shadow waves that appear as a special encounter in the normal floor-oriented Bizarre Room. Seven Gigas Shadows follow. Each one escapes if it hits Sora; use Dumbo's protection and control the group before they surround you. Kill counts 3, 4, 5 and 6 yield Fury Stone rolls of 10%, 20%, 35% and 50%; defeating all seven yields two guaranteed stones. To retry a rare encounter, move two areas away and return with Encounter Plus; without it, leaving and revisiting the world is the reliable reset. A reset does not guarantee a spawn.

entries.name: White Mushroom
entries.summary: Non-hostile spell charade; Mystery Goo, spell materials and Arts.
entries.instructions: Respond only to the current gesture: shivering → Fire; fanning itself → Blizzard; light overhead → Thunder; fallen down → Cure; floating → Gravity; frozen in place → Stop; spinning → Aero. Give three correct spells to finish the encounter. Three of the same spell also give that spell's Arts. Wrong attacks or spells end the attempt. Find early spells in Wonderland's Lotus Forest or Deep Jungle's Camp; advanced spell gestures appear in later-world Mushroom encounters. The three motionless Tree House/Undersea Cave mushrooms are Pink Agaricus triggers, a different challenge. The stat table uses the stated story phase; MP recovery value is an enemy combat parameter, not a castable MP pool. Damage multipliers of x0 indicate immunity. For three correctly requested spells, mixed spells give the final spell's Shard (100%) and Mystery Goo (10%); three of the same spell give that Arts item (100%), its Gem (10%), and Mystery Goo (20%). Use Fire when it shivers, Blizzard when it fans itself, Thunder under a light, Cure when it lies down, Gravity while floating, Aero while spinning, and Stop while frozen in place. Requested gestures depend on the room.

entries.name: Dream weapon and experience choices
entries.summary: Chosen weapon, sacrificed weapon and EXP curve are three separate decisions.
entries.instructions: At Dive to the Heart, your chosen Dream weapon controls Sora's ability order. The sacrificed weapon affects starting stats; it does not replace the chosen-weapon ability schedule. Choosing the Rod provides an extra starting MP and a higher eventual MP total. The later Tidus/Selphie/Wakka questions set Dawn, Midday or Dusk EXP growth; the first responses give Dawn, the middle responses Midday and the last responses Dusk. Dawn gains early levels faster, Dusk needs less total EXP for level 100. These choices are fixed for that save. See each ability for all three Final Mix level unlocks.

entries.name: Experience thresholds and leveling
entries.summary: All 99 level increases, chosen-weapon rewards and complete Sora/party EXP curves.
entries.instructions: Dawn requires less EXP in the early game; Dusk requires the least total EXP for level 100. The full level entries give cumulative thresholds and each individual level cost for all three Sora curves, Donald, Goofy and the guest party members. Values agree between the complete Final Mix guide and documented vanilla battle-table increments. For practical grinding, replay Rock Titan after unlocking Hades opponent selection, or farm Ice Titan Tech EXP with Guard and Tech Boost. Disable EXP Zero to gain EXP.

entries.name: One-of-each synthesis direct totals
entries.summary: Direct ingredient totals for all 33 recipes, before inventory and nested crafting.
entries.instructions: These quantities sum one of each product. They include the one mandatory catalog craft of Mythril and Dark Matter but do not expand additional material crafts or subtract chests. The planner must allocate owned stock once across the whole plan and expand only the selected shortfall. Historical Crafted checks are independent of current stock. A product crafted as an ingredient also satisfies that product's catalog craft; it must not be added a second time.

entries.name: Bambi material farming
entries.summary: Fill Bambi's gauge by defeating enemies during the summon; the world determines the drop family.
entries.instructions: Summon Bambi with 1 MP during ordinary combat. Enemy defeats charge his gauge; his generated MP prizes support continued magic. The first fill guarantees Potion, the second Ether, and the third Hi-Potion in Final Mix. Material rolls depend on both world and gauge-fill count. End of the World, not Traverse Town, supplies Mythril: 20% Mythril Shard at fill two, then 20% Mythril Shard and 10% Mythril at fill three. Many Final Mix special enemies do not charge the gauge. Each linked world row lists the exact conditional material rolls.

entries.name: Bambi rewards — Traverse Town
entries.summary: Blaze Shard at two/three gauge fills; Blaze Gem at the third.
entries.instructions: Summon Bambi in Traverse Town during a fight with enough ordinary enemies. Defeat enemies to fill his Charge Gauge, and collect the MP prizes to sustain your spells. First fill: Potion guaranteed. Second: Ether guaranteed and Blaze Shard 20%. Third: Hi-Potion guaranteed, Blaze Shard 20%, Blaze Gem 20%. These are conditional checkpoint rewards; many special Final Mix enemies do not charge the gauge.

entries.name: Ice Titan
entries.summary: Optional endgame encounter: Diamond Dust.
entries.instructions: Guard the small ice lances back at the Titan until he kneels, then attack his head with aerial combos. Keep moving between volleys. Do not use Aero: it changes the lances into larger projectiles that cannot be reflected. This is a solo encounter.
entries.prerequisites: Clear the Phil, Pegasus, Hercules and Hades Cups.

entries.name: Sephiroth
entries.summary: Optional endgame encounter: One-Winged Angel; Ansem’s Report 12.
entries.instructions: Equip defensive abilities such as Second Chance and Leaf Bracer if learned, set Cure to a shortcut, and carry Elixirs or healing items. Use short punishes after his attacks. Interrupt Heartless Angel before the halo transfers; if it lands, HP becomes 1 and MP becomes 0, so recover immediately with an item. Keep moving during the meteor sequence. Final Mix Sonic Blade does not give invulnerability throughout its follow-up thrusts.
entries.prerequisites: Unlock the first three cups and seal Hollow Bastion’s Keyhole.

entries.name: Kurt Zisa
entries.summary: Optional endgame encounter: Zantetsuken; Ansem’s Report 11.
entries.instructions: Summon before the opening magic seal if using a summon. Break the orbs in his hands with physical attacks, then strike the exposed head. When he raises his barrier, use offensive magic to break it; physical hits on the barrier can supply MP. Dodge the spinning charges rather than chasing them.
entries.prerequisites: After rescuing Kairi in Hollow Bastion, speak to the Carpet in Aladdin’s House.

entries.name: Phantom
entries.summary: Optional endgame encounter: Stop upgrade.
entries.instructions: Carry MP recovery and set Stop to a shortcut. Lock onto the clock hands and cast Stop to delay Doom; renew it regularly. Damage the exposed heart according to its color: white physical, red Fire, blue Blizzard, yellow Thunder. Back away when the heart is absent and preserve MP for the clock.
entries.prerequisites: After rescuing Kairi, put Peter Pan in the party and speak to Tinker Bell in the ship’s Cabin.

entries.name: Unknown
entries.summary: Optional endgame encounter: EXP Necklace; Ansem’s Report 13.
entries.instructions: Prepare healing and MP restoration, and summon Tinker Bell early if desired. Track his teleport cloud and use Gravity to create an opening, then use a brief combo before backing off. If the command menu becomes Shock/Release, select Release to break the curse. Avoid selecting Shock. Save recovery items for the faster closing phase.

sources.label: xenodusk — Final Mix checklist, More Tips

entries.prerequisites: Reach Final Rest in End of the World, then return to Hollow Bastion Castle Chapel and inspect the portal to the former Dragon Maleficent arena.

entries.name: Gummi — no-damage builds
entries.summary: Reduce the exposed silhouette and preserve maneuverability.
entries.instructions: Use the editor to keep blocks compact or away from the central firing lane, with a clear view of incoming shots. Add a shield only when the mission permits it. For Traverse Town 3 and Hollow Bastion 3, remove both Shield-G types. A build is not a substitute for steering; practice the route before combining its other restrictions.

entries.name: Gummi — small-build missions
entries.summary: Count every installed block before launch.
entries.instructions: For End of the World 1, use a cockpit and engine only, then steer through the route without braking or taking damage. For the five-block score mission, budget the remaining slots for weapons that you own. For Neverland 3, stay at ten blocks or fewer and prioritize obstacle coverage. These are starting layouts; adjust placement to your handling and stock.

entries.name: Gummi — collection missions
entries.summary: Collecting drops is a flight objective.
entries.instructions: Use a controllable ship and broad weapon coverage to create drops, then steer through them. Collection parts can help only when allowed: Agrabah 3 prohibits Drain-G and Osmose-G. Avoid a large silhouette for no-damage objectives; Neverland 2 separately requires at least 100 installed blocks.

entries.name: Gummi — weapon-restricted missions
entries.summary: The named weapon type is the only permitted weapon.
entries.instructions: Inspect every weapon in the editor and remove other types. Multiple copies of the permitted type can improve coverage if your stock allows. Keep non-weapon blocks within the mission’s other constraints. Review the departure world as carefully as the weapon rule.

entries.name: Phil’s Training — first test

Break all 20 barrels before the 30-second limit. Follow the linked barrel route for the layout. The check records the initial test clear; repeat practice does not represent another Thunder reward.

entries.name: Racing Riku
entries.summary: Optional day-two race for Pretty Stones.
entries.instructions: Speak to Riku in the Cove on the second day. Reach the star-shaped tree, touch the glowing marker, and return to Kairi before Riku. The beach route reduces precise platforming; practice the turns before attempting the faster treetop path.
entries.prerequisites: Second day on Destiny Islands.

entries.name: Secret ending — Another side, Another story
entries.summary: Unlock the original secret movie under Final Mix rules.
entries.instructions: Finish the game after meeting the condition for your difficulty: Standard (Final Mix) requires all Keyholes sealed and all 99 puppies rescued; Proud requires finishing the game. Beginner cannot unlock this movie. If Deep Dive requirements are satisfied, that movie replaces the shorter one.

entries.name: Secret ending — Deep Dive
entries.summary: Unlock the extended Final Mix secret movie.
entries.instructions: On Standard (Final Mix), complete Jiminy’s Journal before finishing the game. On Proud, seal every Keyhole and clear the Hades Cup before finishing. Beginner cannot unlock this movie. Deep Dive replaces the shorter secret movie when its conditions are met.

entries.name: Completion run planning
entries.summary: Use a thorough run for collection, Journal records and optional encounters.
entries.instructions: Choose Proud if you also want the highest-difficulty clear goal: modern 1.5 + 2.5 difficulty achievements allow higher difficulty to satisfy lower tiers. Explore each world, revisit after movement and Trinity upgrades, then finish synthesis, cups, optional bosses and Gummi missions. A separate fast restricted run can reduce competing goals, but two runs are a recommendation, not a requirement.

entries.name: Restricted run planning
entries.summary: Plan the three conditions separately, with a Beginner run as the straightforward combined route.
entries.instructions: For a combined run, choose Beginner and leave every party member’s weapon and accessories as received, including Sora, Donald and Goofy. Keep Beginner’s pre-equipped accessories in place. Abilities, magic, recovery-item slots and permanent stat-boost items remain usable; improve those instead of replacing equipment. Story-driven weapon changes occur automatically, so continue the story without making manual swaps to compensate. Save regularly in separate slots. For Undefeated, if defeated, return to the title screen and load a clean save instead of selecting Continue. For Speedster, defeat World of Chaos before the in-game timer reaches 15 hours. Plan the route in advance, skip optional cleanup and leave ample time for the final sequence. Let the credits finish and reach the results screen: Steam players report Unchanging Armor and Undefeated unlocking there, while Speedster unlocks at the boss defeat. Check the Steam award before reusing the run save for unrestricted play.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Yuffie
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Yuffie.
entries.instructions: Guard her shuriken to create an opening. Keep pressure on her so she has fewer chances to heal.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Leon & Yuffie
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Leon & Yuffie.
entries.instructions: Focus on Yuffie first to remove her healing. Reflect her shuriken with Guard; once she falls, guard or dodge Leon and attack after his heavy swings.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Cloud
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Cloud.
entries.instructions: Evade his lunging attacks and punish the pause afterward. Keep enough MP for Cure.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Hercules
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Hercules.
entries.instructions: Lock on, lift a barrel, and throw it at Hercules to remove his glowing invulnerability. Attack in the resulting opening, then retreat before his counterattack.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Behemoth
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Behemoth.
entries.instructions: Reach its back and attack the horn. Move away from the charged attack, then return to the horn.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Cerberus
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Cerberus.
entries.instructions: Keep moving around the dark ground eruptions. Attack a head after the biting sequence, and use ranged attacks only when you have spare MP.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Cloud & Leon
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Cloud & Leon.
entries.instructions: Focus damage on one opponent. Cloud has less HP; watch Leon while attacking Cloud and keep a safe reserve for healing.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Hades
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Hades.
entries.instructions: Evade when he turns red and uses fire. Follow the rotation of his large flame attack to stay between the jets; resume damage after he cools down.

entries.name: Coliseum strategy — Rock Titan
entries.summary: Practical encounter guidance for Rock Titan.
entries.instructions: Attack a foot until the Titan falls, then climb to a head and use short aerial combos. Jump over shockwaves.

entries.name: Tidus — Destiny Islands sparring
entries.summary: Optional practice duel on the opening island.
entries.instructions: Parry his stick by attacking as he swings, then strike during the stun. Jump behind him for a short aerial combo and stay inside the arena.
entries.prerequisites: First or second day on Destiny Islands.
entries.missability: Unavailable after leaving Destiny Islands.
entries.reward: 2 EXP; practice toward the three-against-one challenge.

entries.name: Selphie — Destiny Islands sparring
entries.summary: Optional practice duel on the opening island.
entries.instructions: Watch the jump rope, parry its swing, and attack during the opening. Use a direct attack to finish; deflecting the rope alone will not deliver the final blow.
entries.prerequisites: First or second day on Destiny Islands.
entries.missability: Unavailable after leaving Destiny Islands.
entries.reward: 1 EXP; practice toward the three-against-one challenge.

entries.name: Wakka — Destiny Islands sparring
entries.summary: Optional practice duel on the opening island.
entries.instructions: Watch his ball and time a sword swing to send it back. Close in for short attacks while he recovers, then make room for the next throw.
entries.prerequisites: First or second day on Destiny Islands.
entries.missability: Unavailable after leaving Destiny Islands.
entries.reward: 1 EXP; practice toward the three-against-one challenge.

entries.name: Tidus, Selphie and Wakka — team sparring
entries.summary: Optional three-against-one challenge.
entries.instructions: Defeat Tidus, Selphie and Wakka individually, then request the group fight. Focus on Tidus or Selphie first to reduce close-range pressure. Keep Wakka in view and deflect his ball when safe. Each victory awards a Potion.
entries.prerequisites: Defeat each of the three friends individually.
entries.missability: Unavailable after leaving Destiny Islands.

entries.name: Riku — Destiny Islands duel
entries.summary: Optional first-day duel for repeatable Potions.
entries.instructions: Speak to Riku on the small island during the first day. Use brief attacks and jump away when he starts his rising kick. Avoid repeatedly striking his guard, and keep away from the edge: leaving the arena loses the duel. A victory awards a Potion.
entries.prerequisites: First day, before ending the day with Kairi.
entries.missability: First day only.

entries.name: Muddy Path — find all six friends
entries.summary: A complete route through Rabbit, Roo, Tigger, Owl and Piglet after finding Eeyore.
entries.instructions: 1. Speak to Pooh in the mud, then examine the central bushes to find Eeyore. 2. Lock onto Pooh and bring him to the holes beside the well. Face Rabbit when he emerges and select Talk. 3. Strike the exposed tree root in the muddy lower area to bring down Roo, then speak to him. 4. Ride the air rising from the well to the upper ledge. Get onto the hollow log and talk to Tigger. 5. Return to the upper ledge, cross the log and continue uphill. Wait for Owl to land in the corner, then speak to him. 6. Return to Pooh and lock on to guide him to the first blue flowers; they lift him uphill. Lead him to the hollow log, jump over it yourself, then lock on again from the far side so he walks through. Guide him to the next blue flowers and the tree hole. Pooh persuades Piglet to come down. Drop to the lower level and talk to Piglet to finish. For Cheer, finish within five minutes.
entries.prerequisites: Return all five Torn Pages and finish the earlier book episodes.

entries.name: Phil’s barrel training — routes and repeat practice
entries.summary: Efficient routes for the 20-barrel and 25-barrel tests; keep repeat practice separate from the first-clear reward.
entries.instructions: Easy: hit the middle of the first three barrels, a bottom barrel in the four-barrel stack, the bottom center of the six-barrel stack, then a bottom barrel in the next four. Lift and throw one of the last barrels into another. Advanced: clear the four to your left; turn and knock the single barrel toward the two-barrel stack. Throw a survivor toward the raised row of three, then clear that row. On the next level, knock the single toward the four-barrel group and clear the leftovers, then the six-barrel group. Throw the highest loose barrel at the isolated barrel on the elevated platform. Finish the remaining pair at the back with a throw. For practice, improve your own finish time while using the same 30-second and 60-second limits. Thunder is the reward for passing the initial pair of tests.
entries.uncertainty: The reviewed KH1 sources do not document a separate saved replay-record field, replay reward, or higher target beyond the two initial tests. Practice times are personal goals; no KH2 orb-score requirement is imported.

coverage.label: Treasures and one-time world rewards
coverage.notes: Complete declared inventory across 13 worlds, reconciled against all 535 source-table rows and independent Final Mix physical-location data. This 306-record compendium is not an official in-game treasure counter. Specialist collections, temporary story objects and repeatable sources are excluded; simultaneous automatic rewards share acquisition IDs.

coverage.label: World collection routes and turn-in guidance
coverage.notes: 13 world routes, Library puzzle, Trinity unlocks, six repeatable flower references and ten separately checkable postcard mailings. These do not contribute to world collectible counts.

coverage.label: Final Mix synthesis recipes
coverage.notes: 33 distinct products; sets 6/6/6/6/6/3. Energy Bangle reconciled to 2 Spirit Shards using independent KHGuides and dedicated item source. Three Stars corrected to 5 Power Gems. Source-backed, no gameplay verification.

coverage.label: Synthesis materials and farming
coverage.notes: All 34 ingredients, ordinary sources, ten special encounters, and all nine Bambi world/gauge reward tables. Membership complete; no hands-on verification.

coverage.label: Obtainable party weapons
coverage.notes: 18 Keyblades, 15 staves, 15 shields. Explicit Final Mix strength/MP overrides replace mixed-version legacy stats; prices and shop gates included.

coverage.label: Accessory catalog
coverage.notes: All accessories from the KH 1/FM source roster; Final Mix stat overrides applied. Acquisition entries emphasize synthesis/shop/unique reward; every alternative chest is linked through the collectible catalog where available. Three Stars Defense remains an explicit +3/+4 source conflict; roster and recipes are complete.

coverage.label: Acquisition-relevant enemies
coverage.notes: All 44 acquisition-relevant enemy records include practical farming rooms, source world appearances, field-phase HP/Strength/Defense/EXP, effectiveness and Final Mix reward tables. Shadow has 13 world/phase rows. Cup populations/variants are separate records; an exhaustive room-by-room spawn manifest is not claimed.

coverage.label: Abilities and chosen-weapon unlocks
coverage.notes: 65 abilities with AP costs, chosen Sword/Shield/Rod unlocks, party-member unlock clauses and movement abilities; complete 99 level Sora reward matrix links matching abilities. HD Combo Master is Sword 50, Shield 55, Rod 55.

coverage.label: Sora level rewards and complete party EXP curves
coverage.notes: 99 Sora level rewards for all three chosen weapons; exact full Dawn/Midday/Dusk, Donald, Goofy and six-guest EXP curves. Complete guide agrees with sums of documented vanilla battle-table increments. HD Combo Master overlay is included. No hands-on verification; party stat gains are outside this matrix.

coverage.label: Cup rounds and clear variants
coverage.notes: 83 rounds (7 preliminary + 76 main-cup seeds) and 13 clear records (preliminaries + four party/solo/timed variants). Final Mix opponent variants and corrected counts come from current cup tables; legacy CSV transcription errors were not retained. Gold/Platinum encounters are boss records.

coverage.label: Optional endgame boss encounters
coverage.notes: Ice Titan, Sephiroth, Kurt Zisa, Phantom and Unknown, with practical strategies and rewards. Unknown’s exact earliest portal flag remains explicit uncertainty. Five additional Destiny Islands sparring checks are present outside this endgame denominator.

coverage.label: Final Mix Gummi missions
coverage.notes: All 30 destination objectives, departures, rewards and build restrictions. Wonderland 2 specifies at least five Accelerate activations with Haste-G/Haste2-G and no damage, corroborated by a Steam-era guide. Manual checklist, not an automatic game-state validator.

coverage.label: Final Mix Gummi blueprints
coverage.notes: 9 default/NPC, 28 enemy drops, 11 mission rewards. Enemy entries include a sourced route. Ownership is distinct from ship assembly.

coverage.label: Steam KH1 Final Mix achievement goals
coverage.notes: All KH1 goals; excludes PlayStation platinum and other games in Steam app 2552430. Modern stacking and 30-blueprint requirement used. Steam API keys are not exposed by the public page and are not invented; platform-key mapping remains unimplemented.

coverage.label: Minigame clear and Cheer record checks
coverage.notes: Two Phil tests, five fruit courses, four vine courses, five Pooh episodes, five independent Cheer records and Riku’s race. Muddy Path now has a complete linked friends route. A linked Phil route covers both barrel layouts; separate saved replay-record fields and repeat rewards are not established. Early sparring is listed under bosses.

coverage.label: Practical challenge and secret-ending guides
coverage.notes: Cup boss strategies, Gummi builds, Cheer, both secret endings, full Muddy Path route and both Phil barrel routes. Restricted-run guide now covers party equipment planning, allowed ability/item use, clean-save reloads and post-credits award checks with Steam community evidence. Exact scripted-swap flags, guest edge cases and timer/persistence behavior remain targeted gaps.
